introduction: Monica Rodriguez Knox is a Toronto-based actress of Spanish and Portuguese descent whose work spans television, film, theatre, and voice acting. She can be seen in upcoming Lifetime thriller "Sleepover Secrets", for which she plays a leading role. Other upcoming roles include the highly anticipated Hulu/Disney+ series "The Testaments", Hallmark’s "Liberty Bell Romance" and "True Justice: Eye for an Eye" and a comedy indie feature that will be running the festival circuit next year. Previous television credits include a guest-starring role on FX’s "SurrealEstate", FX comedy "Adults", W Network’s "The Love Club: Moms", Hallmark’s "The Jane Mysteries" and "Hearts of Robin Lane" and the award-winning horror anthology series "Tales from the Void". She also lends her voice to Netflix’s popular animated series "Unicorn Academy".Grounded in both her craft and her cultural roots, Monica continues to build a dynamic film and television career while also performing in theatre whenever she gets the chance. She most recently inhabited the role of Magdalena in Modern Times/Aluna Theatre’s co-production of "The House of Bernarda Alba" by Federico García Lorca.Deeply interested in female driven stories, Monica co-hosts, produces, and edits "Hitting Her Mark", a podcast dedicated to highlighting women pursuing creative careers. Monica continues to develop her craft while also expanding into the development of original projects for screen.
